description.en: The application ID, which can be created and queried in the console.

description.zh: 旁路规则ID。您可以通过控制台查询或调用接口[DescribeAutoLiveStreamRule](~~353198~~)获取旁路规则ID。
description.en: The bypass rule ID. You can query it in the console or obtain it by calling the [DescribeAutoLiveStreamRule](~~353198~~) operation.

title.zh: 删除自动旁路单路转推规则
title.en: Delete an automatic single-stream relay rule

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateAutoLiveStreamRule](~~353179~~)创建旁路规则。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
Before you call this operation, you must have called [CreateAutoLiveStreamRule](~~353179~~) to create a bypass rule.
# QPS limit
The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 1,000 calls per minute. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable frequency. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~341645~~).
